change: qcom_iommu: .ias/.oas 32->40 + ARM_32_LPAE_S1 -> ARM_64_LPAE_S1 (3-level, CAF-equivalent); adreno.c: KGSL_MMU_64BIT RESTORED

evidence.smmu: sctlr=0x1167 translating=1, ringbuffer back at 0xfc00b000 (CAF's GLOBAL_MEM_BASE64)
evidence.FSR: 0x80000202 - bit31 MULTI + bit1 TF (translation fault) + FORMAT=01. This is the FIRST genuine SMMU translation fault ever seen; the 32-bit setup only ever had 0x200 (stale).
evidence.CP init failures: 28 'CP initialization failed to idle' - the 32-bit/2-level setup had 0
evidence.SF abort: 'no suitable EGLConfig found, giving up' + SIGABRT - different from run174's GPUOBJ_ALLOC errno 19, but still fatal
evidence.usb_log: 448,816 B - the longest capture of any run; reaches 'init: ... started service surfaceflinger'

conclusion: The CAF-equivalent 3-level/40-bit address space did NOT fix the GPU. It made GPU startup worse (28 CP-init failures vs 0) and left SurfaceFlinger crash-looping on EGLConfig. Its one real value is diagnostic: with the correct table depth the SMMU finally reports actual translation faults (FSR bit1 TF, bit31 MULTI), which the 2-level setup never did. Reverting to the run183/run182 configuration, which is the best working state.
